candidates.description: 너구리, 삼나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 등나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 돈나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: Look out the window, 10003 Raccoon!
candidates.description: 너구리, 벚나무에게 밤고구마 먹이기.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 결국 또 리허설이 중단 돼버렸다. 갑작스레 고함을 지른 '10003 Raccoon 1호'와 대화해 보자.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 10003 Raccoon을 위한 피리를 구해야 한다. 다시 피리 부는 사나이를 만나보자.

candidates.title: 동요하는 동네합창단!
candidates.description: 세 번째 미션 완료. 10003 Raccoon을 위한 '뾰족한 나무 피리'를 3개 구했다. 최종 보고를 위해 알데바란으로 돌아가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 발키리에게서 더 사인을 받았다. 메츠에게 지금까지의 이야기를 들려주자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인을 메츠에게 맡겼다. 메츠의 연구가 끝나길 기다려 되돌려 받으러 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인의 봉인을 풀기 위해 엥겔 하워드를 찾아 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 더 사인을 엥겔에게 맡겼다. 엥겔의 작업이 끝나길 기다려 되돌려 받으러 가자.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: 메츠에게 돌아가 봉인이 풀린 더 사인을 보여주자.

candidates.title: My country is calling me!
candidates.description: 의뢰소에서 받은 의뢰. 게펜 던전 1층에서 실종된 청년을 찾아서 구출하자.

candidates.title: Zonda
candidates.description: Zonda event, i won her heart.

candidates.title: Devil in the Cave
candidates.description: People say the monster is not appearing at the moment. Should come back tomorrow.

candidates.title: Immortal Heart Doc.
candidates.description: Heart that never stops beating. Obtained from mystical creatures called mermaids. The driving force of the heart is still unknown and worth researching.

candidates.title: Rotten Bandage Doc.
candidates.description: Bandage used for dead bodies. Looks like humans believed in the dead coming back for their bodies.

candidates.title: Decayed Nail Doc.
candidates.description: Nail from a dead body. Important material for research on time of death and health conditions. Useful in discovering human ecology.

candidates.title: Horrendous Mouth Doc.
candidates.description: Tooth from a dead body. Important material for research on time of death and health conditions. Useful in discovering human ecology.

candidates.title: Tentacle Doc.
candidates.description: Feeler from ocean creatures. Unlike those from insects, these show active movement.

candidates.title: Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shell protecting insects or crustacean creatures. These creatures have a shell surrounding their skin and are very flexible in movement. Worth researching.

candidates.title: Scale Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shiny scales found from some reptiles. The fluorescent substance contained on the surface can be used in various places.

candidates.title: Venom Canine Doc.
candidates.description: Canine tooth with poison. Humans use this to make weapons for defeating.

candidates.title: Sticky Mucus Doc.
candidates.description: Sticky liquid with a bit of viscosity left. Can be used as key material for construction and currently is used for some Manuk architecture style. Commonly found throughout Midgard.

candidates.title: Bee Sting Doc.
candidates.description: Stinger taken from a living insect. Some humans use it for medical treatment for its medicinal effect.

candidates.title: Grasshopper's Leg Doc.
candidates.description: Back legs of an insect that can leap far. Fun to research its structure.

candidates.title: Royal Jelly Doc.
candidates.description: A kind of wonder drug collected from a queen bee. Humans love this but no efficacy found for Manuk.

candidates.title: Yoyo Tail Doc.
candidates.description: Tail from a humanlike creature. Research on why humans do not have this trace on them would be amusing but would hurt current alliance with the humans.

candidates.title: Solid Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Shell evolved by some kind of environmental factor. This can be great material to make various tool or armory.

candidates.title: Yam Doc.
candidates.description: Edible when ripe, yellow food. Humans like this very much. Haven't tried it yet but smells like ripe sweet Potatoes.

candidates.title: Raccoon Leaf Doc.
candidates.description: They say there is an animal that can change its form with this pasted on it. Worth research to validate if this rumor is true.

candidates.title: Snail's Shell Doc.
candidates.description: Hard Carapace that protects the body of a huge snail. Creature fun to research out of pure curiousity.

candidates.title: Horn Doc.
candidates.description: Hard wedge-like horn from some insects. Doesn't have much practical use.

candidates.title: Bear's Footskin Doc.
candidates.description: Humans collect hunted bear paws. Usage is unknown. The humans that collect the paws are subjects for research.

candidates.title: Feather Doc.
candidates.description: Warm hair as soft as downy hair. Must be used for cold protection. Collectable throughout Midgard.

candidates.title: Red Herb Doc.
candidates.description: Kind of medicinal red plant. Humans use this to make recovery medicine. Plant worth researching.

candidates.title: Carrot Doc.
candidates.description: Red colored plant. Pub owner requests it all the time. Worth research.

candidates.title: Cactus Needle Doc.
candidates.description: Surface of a plant that survives in deserts with almost no moisture.

candidates.title: Stone Heart Doc.
candidates.description: They say a huge stone in a dead area in Midgard moves by itself. The heart of the huge stone would be a rare research subject.

candidates.title: Pouty Jahbong
candidates.description: Jahbong seems to be pouting seriously. You cannot talk with Jahbong for 6 hours. Would it be helpful to give him fish?

candidates.title: Request - Traces of wild boar hunt
candidates.description: As it seems ineffective only to raid Savages, we need a special operation. Slay living and fresh savages, come back to me with 30 manes of savages. I will warn them by spreading it on the road that they use to attack.

candidates.title: Lava Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 40 blazing hearts at the hottest place of the 2nd floor of Thor Volcano Dungeon.

candidates.title: Flame Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Live Coals in the stable ground of Thor Volcano Dungeon.

candidates.title: Glacier Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Glacial Hearts deep inside the Ice Cave.

candidates.title: Fossil Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Jubilees on the 2nd floor of the Mine Dungeon.

candidates.title: Storm Essence Creation
candidates.description: Refine 10 Denture from Dragon Masks in the Kunlun dungeon.

candidates.title: Fruit-Carrying Insects
candidates.description: I'd like you to take them out as you see them, before they try to sell anything to the adventurers lost in the forest.

candidates.title: Flowery Hunters
candidates.description: No casualties have been reported yet, but it wouldn't hurt to take precautions. Please deal with them appropriately.

candidates.title: Small but Ferocious...
candidates.description: They didn't look so ferocious... but the adventurer has asked me to get rid of them, so you'll have to do it.

candidates.title: An Unknown Grudge
candidates.description: I don't know what grudge he has against the fairies, but a request is a request.

candidates.title: Blondie Ann
candidates.description: They don't seem so dangerous, but they are reported to steal books and sweets from adventurers. Please deal with them appropriately.

candidates.title: Request timer
candidates.description: Elephantine doesn't have anymore tasks available today.
candidates.goal: Wait for the timer to expire

candidates.title: Material for the Preservative
candidates.description: *grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...

candidates.title: A Symbol of Resistance
candidates.description: Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.

candidates.title: Material for First Aid Kits
candidates.description: They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials. The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.

candidates.title: Symbols of Courage
candidates.description: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.

candidates.title: Good for Stamina...
candidates.description: The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.

candidates.title: The Latest Trend in Talismans
candidates.description: Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.

candidates.title: Keep Your Valuables Safe
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.

candidates.title: Material for Shin Guards
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make shin guards.

candidates.title: Poison for Poison...
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.

candidates.title: Don't Slip and Fall
candidates.description: The Commodities Dealer across from me commissioned me to get five globs of Sticky Mucus.

candidates.goal: Wait for the timer to expire

candidates.description: No more tasks are available today from Woof-grrr

candidates.title: Information on missing person Tazar
candidates.description: Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Survival not likely.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 13, 10

candidates.title: Information on missing person Nigel
candidates.description: Age 19. Adventurer who came from far away unknown place by ship. He has been missing for 2 months since he went to explore Maze dressed thin tights despite the protests of all of Mora's residents.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 10, 24

candidates.title: Information on missing person Messil
candidates.description: Age unknown. Has little bit of a mental illness. He went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 14, 24

candidates.title: Information on missing person Noirit
candidates.description: Age 51. He used to be a biggest thief who stole famous swords from all over the world. He's gone missing in the Maze after being pursued for running illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 19, 27

candidates.title: Information on missing person Pajama Sin
candidates.description: Age 22. Pilot cadet of airship. He has gone missing during his leave while drinking in Mora town. Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Has been missing for 4 months. Slim chance of survival.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 30, 32

candidates.title: Information on missing person Mendel^
candidates.description: Age Unknown. A Female with long hair dressed black. Go on an expedition to the forest of Maze for search for eternal life. Has been missing for 3 months. Slim chance of survival.
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 33, 28

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Milebit
candidates.description: Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught from pocketing profit by cheating residence. Survival uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 33, 17

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Kunmoon
candidates.description: Age 29. A young man with unknown background. Fled to the forest of maze after scamming 1200 Mora coins from Mora residents while pretending to start a lot of business and adapting himself in Mora. Survival uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 28, 8

candidates.title: Information on the missing person Chaihokin
candidates.description: Age 34.Flurted with several women in Mora. Fled from Mora villagers to the forest of maze. Survival Uncertain
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 17, 5

candidates.title: Information on missing person Tual
candidates.description: Age Unknown.Disappered with coins which were joint controlled by the villagers. Slim Chance of Survival
candidates.goal: Search the Fog Maze Forest around 11, 4

candidates.title: Towards Bakonawa Lake...
candidates.description: Entered the lake to stop Bakonawa. Don't think I need to go back into the lake within the week.

candidates.title: Get Rid of Bakonawa
candidates.description: A huge fight will break out if Bakonawa is left as is. He must be defeatd.

candidates.title: A suspicious prisoner
candidates.description: It seems that a suspicious prisoner is in jail. Wouldn't be nice to hear about his story for once?

candidates.title: An unwanted favor
candidates.description: Clever asks for 1 ^000099Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000. It is a big favor coming from a prisoner, but try to obtain it when possible.

candidates.title: Gossip king Clever
candidates.description: Clever knows lots of gossip stories. Since his knowledge may be helpful for future adventures, let's listen to them. There may be very useful information.

candidates.title: The rift researcher
candidates.description: There is a young Dona named ^000099Hielle^000000 who is known to carry out research related to rift fragments. Look for the researcher.

candidates.title: A cat merchant's source of information
candidates.description: Among cat merchants, there is a cat that is supposed to know a lot about Midgard research on rifts. Look for ^000099Midgard Post^000000 known for its activity.
candidates.goal: A cat merchant's source of information

candidates.title: A way to calm down a cat
candidates.description: If the cat is stopped from fighting, it may be possible to gain useful information. How can it be calmed down? Did they say that they could not get their monthly salary of ^000099Malangdo Canned Specialties^000000?
candidates.goal: A way to calm down a cat

candidates.title: Information traded for some canned foods
candidates.description: It is told that ^0000991 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue gemstones^000000 are needed for activating the rift fragment. It seems that Hiel is having a hard time obtaining them…
candidates.goal: Information traded for some canned foods

candidates.title: A weird experience
candidates.description: Experiment with Hiel whether sufficient reaction occurs with the rift fragment.

candidates.title: A successful experience
candidates.description: With Hiel's current arrangement, it doesn't seem like it will react properly. Try touching the experimental setup to activate it.

candidates.title: Another visitation
candidates.description: The identities found through the rift reaction must be actual figures from history. Ask Clever the historian about them.

candidates.title: Clever's historical documents
candidates.description: There are individuals that seem to be Lapines according to Clever's historical documents. Listen to his stories.

candidates.title: Hidden historical documents (?)
candidates.description: According to Clever's drawn diagram, the document doesn't seem too hidden. Rather, it seems well presented on the shelves. Look for places where books are organized in Eclage.

candidates.title: The unknown ones
candidates.description: Individuals responsible for constructing the Home Tree and restoring the land of Bifrost are not the Elder's Assembly, but two unknown Dona's. Ask Clever about two Donas named Etran and Robert.

candidates.title: Figures in history
candidates.description: Clever asked to directly talk with the historical figures of the past through the rift device. Not sure if it is possible, but go visit Hiel.

candidates.title: Tour of Eclage
candidates.description: Take Robert who appeared in the past around the many places of Eclage. Wouldn't he be touched if he were to see the current state of Home Tree?

candidates.title: Error
candidates.description: Robert suddenly vanished. Go back to Hiel to figure out if something went wrong with the rift device.

candidates.title: Fun times with the reactor
candidates.description: Use Hiel's rift reactor to explore various areas of Eclage. There may be a place where Etran appears.

candidates.title: Encountering Etran
candidates.description: The location where Etran can be reached was found. It would be a good chance to confirm whether he was responsible for restoring the land.

candidates.title: Two wishes
candidates.description: Deliver Etran's necklace to Robert. Obtain Home Tree's golden leaf. Two favors were asked. Ask Hiel about the method to obtain a Home Tree leaf.

candidates.title: Revisiting Robert
candidates.description: It is prohibited to injure Home Tree by obtaining a leaf. However, if the creator himself provides one, it may be okay. However, wasn't Robert just abandoned in front of Home Tree last time?

candidates.title: Revisitng Etran
candidates.description: Show Home Tree's leaf and encourage Etran. Although Robert's refusal to receive the necklace was critical...

candidates.title: Two remaining friends
candidates.description: Robert and Etran will carry out their destinies until the end. Until the land of the past (although present for them…) becomes the abundant land of the present. Talk with Hiel and Clever who made the encounters possible.

candidates.title: Salim Hamid
candidates.description: Talked with a merchant trainer named Salim Hamid.

candidates.title: Applicant for trader
candidates.description: They say the only person with 100 zeny is entiled to take Salim Hamid's famous merchant lesson. It isn't that much zeny so you need to find and sell some items.

candidates.title: Introduction to merchantology
candidates.description: Merchants have various skills to make money legally. Listen to the explanations from the steward next to Salim Hamid.

candidates.title: About the capability figure
candidates.description: Merchants also have the main element status. Simply study each status' capability figure. Of course, it's up to you...
candidates.goal: It is not pushing you to do

candidates.title: Experience of disounts
candidates.description: Go to the noisy vending machine in merchant classroom, come back after checking discounted prices of Garlets and Zargons. To check the discounted prices, you must equip the merchant manual.
candidates.goal: See discounts by wearing the Merchant Manual

candidates.title: Way to the Merchant
candidates.description: According to Salim Hamid, to change to a Merchant, you should go to the town of Alberta. Go to the refinery building in the 5 o'clock direction.

candidates.title: Removal of Worm Tails
candidates.description: Recently there have been lots of packages being delivered to Prontera. For a smoother delivery, you need to reduce the numbers of Worm Tails near Alberta. Return after hunting 20 Worm Tails

candidates.title: Removal of Boa
candidates.description: More frequently accidents have been happening to the mushroom collecting merchants mistakenly touching snakes. Come back to the collecting merchant after hunting 20 Boas.

candidates.title: Removal of Spore
candidates.description: Groceries being delivered to the Capital are becoming polluted with the Spore's seeds. Return to the collecting merchant after hunting 20 Spores

candidates.title: Removal of Pirate Skeletons
candidates.description: Salim Hamid seems to like to use the abandoned boat near Alberta after repairs. Return after removing 10 Pirate Skeletons.

candidates.title: supplementary to the theory lesson
candidates.description: Told Salim Hamid to listen to the theory lesson.

candidates.title: About stats
candidates.description: Decided to take the theory lesson about the effect of the merchant status.

candidates.title: About skills
candidates.description: Repeat the theory lesson about merchant skills even though you've gone through it before.
candidates.goal: Repeat the lesson about the merchant skills

candidates.title: Meeting Hugin
candidates.description: Finally met Hugin for the first time. He probably remembers me, but not sure I would do the same.

candidates.title: Trace of Time Travel
candidates.description: Time travel to Old Glast Heim has been prohibited for 23hours.

candidates.title: Corrupted Soul Hunt
candidates.description: Find and destroy the Corrupted Soul located in Old Glast Heim 1F.

candidates.title: Amdarais Hunt
candidates.description: Proceed to the 2nd floor of Old Glast Heim and destroy Amdarais

candidates.title: Time Traveler
candidates.description: Time travel to Old Glastheim has been partially finished.

candidates.title: Time Conqueror
candidates.description: Time travel to Old Glastheim has been completely finished.

candidates.title: Space Distortion
candidates.description: Space inside of Glastheim has been distorted by Hugin. Anything can happen inside of this castle.

candidates.title: Faceworm's Nest after-effects
candidates.description: You cannot re-enter the Faceworm's Nest until the timer has expired.

candidates.title: The owner of old ring
candidates.description: You have discovered the owner of the old ring.

candidates.title: Wuhari's concern
candidates.description: Wuhari is worried about his brother in prison. Find a way into the prison and deliver Wuhari's heartfelt letter to his brother in jail.

candidates.title: Test of patience
candidates.description: The prisoner does not respond when talked to. He seems to test my patience.

candidates.title: Test of patience 2
candidates.description: The prisoner still does not respond even after being talked to multiple times. Let's try again.

candidates.title: Test of patience 3
candidates.description: The guy seems to keep his mouth shut no matter what. I wonder if there are any other ways.

candidates.title: Time for two
candidates.description: Wuhari's letter was delivered to Wuhuru. He asked for some time to read the letter. Don't bother him when he's reading the letter.
candidates.goal: Give him time to read the letter

candidates.title: Wuhuru's favor
candidates.description: After reading his brother's letter, Wuhuru began to share his story extensively and asked to send his brother his regards. Go back to Wuhari and give him his brother's regards.

candidates.title: First Request
candidates.description: Jade's animal was stolen last night. Investigate it and report what is happened.

candidates.title: Investigating the area
candidates.description: Wuhari is searching for ways to recover Wuhuru's body. However, he doesn't know how. Wouldn't people in the nearby areas know something? investigate the areas nearby.
candidates.goal: Talk with people in the town

candidates.title: Searching for Ms. Goatie
candidates.description: Mr. Masione said he does not know much at all. But refers to Ms. Goatie who is a lot sharper with these things…

candidates.title: Searching for Ms. Goatie's husband
candidates.description: Ms. Goatie talked about how Wuhuru was very happy while shaking a piece of paper in the air. When asked about the paper, she said that her husband may know more about it.

candidates.title: Obtaining the research report
candidates.description: Mr. Svery who was always close with Wuhuru knew something more. Inside the letter that Wuhuru left before being taken to prison was the research report. Take it to Wuhari.

candidates.title: Analysis time
candidates.description: Wuhari received the report, but stated that it will take some time to analyze the report. Try talking to him a bit later. Don't bother someone when he is studying.

candidates.title: Our Research
candidates.description: After the animal is found, first we have to investigate what's going on.

candidates.title: Another favor
candidates.description: Wuhari analyzed the research report, but he was still unsure about how to recover his brother's body. Try finding and asking the Lapine who originally requested Wuhuru's participation in research.

candidates.title: Sharp Ms. Goatie
candidates.description: Although Mr. Svery was visited for more insight, he said that he has no idea about the high-level Lapine. However, he suggested seeing his wife who's sharp with these things.

candidates.title: Searching for Mr. Pompe
candidates.description: When asked about the high-level Lapine's whereabouts, Ms. Goatie did not know much. However, a neighbor in town, Mr. Pompe, shared that he saw a Lapine in the field who later disappeared. Let's ask Mr. Pompe in more detail.
candidates.goal: Hearing the story from Mr. Pompe

candidates.title: A terrible scene in the field
candidates.description: Mr. Pompe is afraid of going out to the field. He talked about how a big corpse has been lying there ever since one high-level Lapine suffered a terrible death. Investigate the field.

candidates.title: An interesting proposition
candidates.description: One Lapine girl made an interesting proposition. It seemed that the Lapine who gave Wuhuru the research report is the same person as her lost father. Let's look for him together.

candidates.title: The big corpse
candidates.description: There was a big corpse that seemed to have been there a while. He was the Lapine that everyone has been looking for. We have to let the girl know this bad news.

candidates.title: To Wuhuru
candidates.description: The girl confirmed that the corpse was her father's. I have to go back to Wuhari empty-handed since the Lapine of interest has died. Before that, let's go to Wuhuru to tell him about the Lapine he had worked with.

candidates.title: To Wuhari
candidates.description: Wuhuru shared all of his story, but that cannot be shared in its entirely to Wuhari. Go to Wuhari to at least tell him that the Lapine has died.

candidates.title: Ingredients for research
candidates.description: Wuhari asked for ingredients that he could use to research on his own. Provide Wuhari with his necessary ingredients. (1 Wing piece, 1 sturdy hair, 1 Bradium, 1 rune of darkness, 1 rune of blood).

candidates.title: To the Archer's town!
candidates.description: Finish the lesson by going to the Archer's Guild by going to Payon and traveling north.

candidates.title: Application for the Archer's job change
candidates.description: At last, applied for the archer's job change! Go to the Archer's job change at the Archer's Guild.

candidates.title: Retest - Stats
candidates.description: Take the test again after deeply learning about your stats once again.

candidates.title: Archer Skills
candidates.description: Listen to the details about Archer skills.

candidates.title: Hunting training
candidates.description: Theory study is good but the field exercise is the best! Try the hunting training with the eagle's eye trainer.

candidates.title: Retest - Skills
candidates.description: Take the test again after deeply learning about skills once again.

candidates.title: To the next step
candidates.description: Listen to the explanation about the 2nd job change.

candidates.title: Listening to the 2nd job change
candidates.description: There are Hunter, Bard, Dancer for Archer's 2nd job class. Students should learn from hunter PR staffs. Dancer PR staff is out of position now, Bard staff will give explanation for dancer class also.
candidates.goal: Listening to the explanation about the 2nd job classes

candidates.title: To the next step
candidates.description: Go and see Mr. Marlborn

candidates.title: Hunting training - Spore
candidates.description: The 1st step of hunting training. Report after hunting 10 Spores

candidates.title: Hunting training - Creamy
candidates.description: The 2nd step of hunting training. Report after hunting 10 Creamy.

candidates.title: Hunting training - Skeleton
candidates.description: The 3rd step of hunting training. Report after hunting 10 Skeletons

candidates.title: Fragrant herb mix
candidates.description: To make the fragrant herb mix, the ingredients are required. Find and bring one of each Clover, Green Herb and Red Herb.

candidates.title: Crunchy salad
candidates.description: To make the crunchy salad, the ingredients are required. Find and bring 1 Apple and 2 Carrots.

candidates.title: Anything shabushabu
candidates.description: To make the anything shabushabu, the ingredients are required. Find and bring 1 of each Jellopy, Fluff, Feather.

candidates.title: Baked golden apple
candidates.description: To make the baked golden apple, the ingredients are required. Find and bring him 1 of each Apple and Clover.

candidates.title: Presentation of the Archer manual
candidates.description: Presentation of the guide to experience the archer's skill

candidates.title: Met with the PR staff
candidates.description: Met with the hunter's PR staff

candidates.title: Met with the PR staff
candidates.description: Met with the PR staff for Bard and Dancer

candidates.title: Test of stats
candidates.description: Take the test from the Archer Trainer about stats.

candidates.title: Test of skills
candidates.description: Take the test from the Archer Trainer about skills.

candidates.title: Caught Spores
candidates.description: Caught 10 Spores

candidates.title: Caught Creamy
candidates.description: Caught 10 Creamy

candidates.title: Caught Skeletons
candidates.description: Caught 10 Skeletons.

candidates.title: Invaded Prontera
candidates.description: Annie said that she will meet you near the Castle Gates in Prontera She said she will be hiding so you may have to search.

candidates.title: Fruit Gardener
candidates.description: Find the Fruit Gardener you think you remember her stall being in south west Prontera

candidates.title: To the Mercenary guild
candidates.description: In order to enter the castle, you will need to get help. Go to the Mercenary guild to see if anyone is alive.

candidates.title: Defeat the Orc Archers
candidates.description: You've agreed to do a favor for the Guild leader. Defeat 50 Orc Archers and try to keep the Mercenary alive.

candidates.title: Father Thyme
candidates.description: Father Thyme has a request for the Mercenary guild. Go to Prontera Church and speak to Father Thyme.

candidates.title: Get the Supplies
candidates.description: All the soldiers were attacked when they were delivering aid to the Church. Find supplies in the abandoned buildings of Prontera.
candidates.goal: 5 clean bandages, 5 rubbing alcohols, 5 Sour grass, 5 First aid kit, 5 relief food

candidates.title: Back to the castle
candidates.description: Father Thyme sent some of recovered soldiers to defeat some of Orcs near castle. Let's go back to the castle entrance.

candidates.title: Defeat the Gatekeeper!
candidates.description: The Gatekeeper found out that we are trying to get in to the castle. Defeat the Gatekeeper!

candidates.title: Enter the castle!
candidates.description: The Gatekeeper is gone. Go into the castle and find out the Orc's plans.

candidates.title: Beyond the Portal
candidates.description: A Goblin Shaman is trying to open the portal. Stop their plan by entering the portal.

candidates.title: To Payon Cave
candidates.description: Annie was told that there is a clue for stopping the Orcs. Let's go to Payon Cave to find it.

candidates.title: Find a clue 1
candidates.description: The owner of the dairy said he hid the note which has a way to stop this threat somewhere. Let's find a clue.

candidates.title: Find a clue 2
candidates.description: The owner of the dairy said he hid the note which has a way to stop this threat somewhere. Let's find a clue.

candidates.title: To Glast Heim
candidates.description: There is a note from the owner of dairy in the Glast Heim. Find the note near the center of the church.

candidates.title: To Lighthalzen
candidates.description: Somewhere in Lighthalzen Lab, there is an old machine that owner of the dairy mentioned.

candidates.title: Report to Annie
candidates.description: You got the Note and the weird machine. Show them to Annie.

candidates.title: Final match with Orc leader
candidates.description: The Orc leader has arrived. Defeat him amd save Prontera!

candidates.title: Repeat time
candidates.description: Wait for the timer to expire before taking on the Orcs again. Speak to Annie in Prontera if you wish to take the Orcs on again.

candidates.title: Boss Hat
candidates.description: Give the Boss hat

candidates.title: Finding sculptor
candidates.description: My wife wants me to make her a statue but the sculptor won't meet me. please meet him instead of me. if you are also rejected from him, find his apprentice.

candidates.title: Return to the sculptor
candidates.description: The apprentice told you that he heard his master speaking to himself!

candidates.title: Find the Alchemist
candidates.description: The sculptor says maybe an Alchemist can help turn stone to flesh! He heard of one around Mjolnir field 3

candidates.title: Find the monk
candidates.description: The Alchemist said that a monk may be able to help you with giving life to stone and he might be east of Prontera.

candidates.title: Find the Dark Priest
candidates.description: Find a Dark Priest at the Glastheim Graveyard.

candidates.title: Return to Mario
candidates.description: Ask the sculptor Mario how far he is willing to go in order to make his Maria statue come to life.

candidates.title: I'm ready
candidates.description: Mario is determined to do whatever it takes to bring his beloved Maria statue to life.
candidates.goal: return to the Dark Priest in Glastheim

candidates.title: Ritual offerings
candidates.description: 3 Seed of Yggdrasil, 44 Immortal Heart, 1 Cursed Ruby and 3 Star Crumb

candidates.title: Back to the sculptor
candidates.description: Bring the offerings to the sculptor in Morocc

candidates.title: Something is amiss
candidates.description: Something must be wrong! The spell wasn't effective even though all the offerings were there!

candidates.title: More ritual offerings
candidates.description: There are some missing part from offering. 3 Cursed Water, 3 Holy Water and 1 Hand-Made Chocolate. Bring them to statue and do ritual again, it will work this time!

candidates.title: Soft stone
candidates.description: Now you need soft stones. You can find them after defeating Stalactic Golems.

candidates.title: soft stone
candidates.description: Now you need soft stones. You can find them after defeating Bradium Golems.

candidates.title: 24 hours
candidates.description: I have enough material for today, please come back later.

candidates.title: Take care of my honey
candidates.description: My darling said he is preparing a proposal event and it makes me nervous. Can you check up on him? He is in Geffen.

candidates.title: Legendary Florist
candidates.description: Eh... I heard there is the legendary Florist in Morocc area.. Can you check up on him? He hasn't answered any of my messages.

candidates.title: No water?!
candidates.description: Humm...this is odd..water is not running. It is crucial to grow my flowers. Would you meet the Water facility manager in Morocc? And the fertilizer didn't arrive here yet. please visit Payon once.

candidates.title: Unknown issue
candidates.description: Ah, I was also wondering what happened cause I thought engineers will finish in a day but it is not done yet, please find them around the Morocc Oasis

candidates.title: Need fertilizer
candidates.description: Though the process was slow it will be done according to schedule. Now it is time to find fertilizer in Payon

candidates.title: To the florist
candidates.description: There is nothing you can do. Should visit the florist to inform him of this situation

candidates.title: matchmaking - Morocc
candidates.description: Why don't you be a matchmaker? Bring a Chocolate Drink with you, it would be helpful.

candidates.title: matchmaking - Geffen
candidates.description: Why don't you be a matchmaker? Bring a Chocolate Drink with you, it would be helpful.

candidates.title: To the florist
candidates.description: Matchmaking success!! Visit the florist and get a Seed from him!

candidates.title: Got a seed
candidates.description: let's go back to Hans with the seed.

candidates.title: To Al de baran
candidates.description: let's go back to Al de baran to inform that Hans' preparation was okay.

candidates.title: To Geffen
candidates.description: would the proporsal be successful with a blossom flower? Should visit once again there to check up.

candidates.title: Strange Fertilizer
candidates.description: In order to grow these special flowers I need the best natural fertilizer. You can get it by hunting Sasquatch monsters at Lutie.

candidates.title: Strange Fertilizer
candidates.description: In order to grow these special flowers I need the best natural fertilizer. You can get it by hunting Tatacho monsters at Ash Vacuum.

candidates.title: 24 hours
candidates.description: i have enouth fertilizer for today. Please come back later.

candidates.title: Gathering Chocoins
candidates.description: Nervous Bitta. he is struggling to recollect Chocoins. Recollect Chocoins by defeating Chocos.
candidates.goal: Bring Chocoins to Bitta in Einbroch

candidates.title: Look around the Walther Family
candidates.description: The Wigner family seems rather quiet. Look around and meet Isenhonor who seemed upset.

candidates.title: In Search of the Guardian Knight
candidates.description: My Guardian Knight may know nothing. If you have to meet him, you can go to our manor in the south of Alberta.

candidates.title: To the Royal Prison
candidates.description: There must be a thief named Big Foot trapped in the prison of Prontera Palace. You may hear something from him. Please tell Isenhonor that I would be waiting for his order as always.

candidates.title: Gourmet Bigfoot
candidates.description: I want to have 3 Spicy Fried Bao and 1 Green Salad. You need to bring them to me to hear my story.

candidates.title: To Veins
candidates.description: He was in Veins. He really was in Veins!

candidates.title: Report to Isenhonor
candidates.description: You have received the letter sent by Isenarm from his Guardian Knight. Let's go back to Isenhonor now.

candidates.title: To Jurgen
candidates.description: Speak more to Jurgen the candidate for the throne.

candidates.title: To Levuiere and His Wife
candidates.description: Why don't you go have a cup of tea with my parents if you have time? They really enjoy haring the stories from the adventures.

candidates.title: What Is Going on?
candidates.description: Katrin, has anything happened to my baby? I wouldn't be able to live if anything has happened to her.

candidates.title: Searching for the Clue
candidates.description: A maid was here to clean the room. Let's go ask her about the whereabouts of the box.

candidates.title: Clean-up out of Apology
candidates.description: Who else was there? I don't know... I may remember if this place becomes clean again. Would you clean it for me? Oh, thank you. You first need to wipe the mold on the wall, remove the grease and clean the floor.

candidates.title: Conquer the Grease
candidates.description: You need the mixture of orange and alcohol to clean the grease. Bring 1 Orange and 1 Alcohol.
candidates.goal: Get the materials for the clean-up

candidates.title: Conquer the Mold
candidates.description: You cannot get rid of the mold without the power of its own kind and the power of god. Bring 1 Mold Powder and 1 Holy Water!
candidates.goal: Get the materials for the clean-up

candidates.title: Conquer the Dirt of Devil
candidates.description: In order to remove the target, you need 1 Lemon and 1 Powdery Sand! Go get them now! Go!
candidates.goal: Get the materials for the clean-up

candidates.title: Report the Completion of the Clean-up
candidates.description: The cleaning is completed. Go to see the maid to report and hear her story.

candidates.title: There Was a Furniture Delivery Man
candidates.description: There was a man delivering the furniture all day. That's why I had to stay there all day to clean the room. He must be near the village office. There are many stores in the area.

candidates.title: I Am Upset
candidates.description: Oh, I have been good all my life, and this is what I get? Oh, I have no power to live on... However, 3 Ox Head Slices may cheer me up.

candidates.title: I Heard the Story
candidates.description: You have heard the story. Let's go back to the palace to report to Jurgen.

candidates.title: Please Find the Token of Memory
candidates.description: In order to cheer up my sister, we may have to bring the things your sister has cherished. Let's bring 10 Sea Stones and 1 Witherless Rose. You can get the Sea Stones when you hunt the Medusa.

candidates.title: Please Deliver My Love
candidates.description: Please let her know of my love for her. Please help me.

candidates.title: I Have to Turn It Down
candidates.description: I have never expected this, and I feel pressured. Moreover, I have a reason that I cannot see someone now. Please deliver my words to him without hurting his feelings.

candidates.title: My Love Once More
candidates.description: I want to show her my heart as wide as the sea and my undying passion. Please deliver my love for her with 15 Sea Stones which can be acquired upon hunting the Medusa, and 1 Witherless Rose.

candidates.title: I Have to Turn It Down Again
candidates.description: I am sorry... But I am actually... Please tell Prince Wigner about it without hurting his feelings.

candidates.title: There Is a Silver Lining
candidates.description: Would you come back again later? Just enough time for her so that she doesn't feel pressured without forgetting me. After some time, I'd like to deliver my hear to her again!

candidates.title: Today I Feel
candidates.description: What should I do? I like Mary even more today. Please deliver my love for her with 15 Sea Stones which can be acquired upon hunting the Medusa, and 1 Witherless Rose.

candidates.title: I Have to Turn It Down Again
candidates.description: Please, I really appreciate his feelings. However, I cannot accept it. Please tell him without hurting his feelings.

candidates.title: To Wolf
candidates.description: Let's hear the story about the family from Wolf Roegenburg.

candidates.title: To Isaac
candidates.description: If you meet Isaac of the Wigner family, please hand him the thing I asked you for. The Wigner residence is at the end of the hallway.

candidates.title: Delivery for Wolf
candidates.description: Please deliver the box to Wolf. You have to be careful with it. It is dangerous.

candidates.title: Which Rumor
candidates.description: If there is a bad rumor about our family going around in Prontera, I cannot just wait and see. I need to know what the rumor is about to deal with it. Please collect the rumors for me. You may hear them from young children.

candidates.title: Prove Yourself
candidates.description: Prove that you are eligible to hear the story. Hunt 33 Majoruros! And bring the history book of Rune Midgarts from the library! Oh, I also need 12 Soft Silk Cloth!

candidates.title: Complete checking out the book
candidates.description: You have checked out the history book of Rune Midgarts.

candidates.title: Report to Wolf
candidates.description: Since you have heard the rumor, let's go to see Wolf and tell him the whole story.

candidates.title: To Isaac
candidates.description: Please hand this document to Isaac. I have a lot of things to do from now. I am defending on you then.

candidates.title: Report to Wolf
candidates.description: Please tell Wolf that I respect his decision and trust him as always.

candidates.title: In Search of Helmut
candidates.description: Would you persuade Helmut and bring him to me? He would be at the Schwaltzvalt Border Garrison.

candidates.title: I Won't go Back
candidates.description: I belong here. Please tell my grandfather that.

candidates.title: Things Turned out This Way
candidates.description: Please tell Myer who left the home that the things have turned out this way at home. He may run away if one of the family members go there.

candidates.title: To Maximilian
candidates.description: It turned out well. Everything is all right now. Please tell him that I'll go visit him when the banquet is over.

candidates.title: Jewel and Cloth
candidates.description: Please bring 3 Pearls and 50 strands of soft hair.

candidates.title: Still Making It
candidates.description: I am still in the progress of making it with what you have brought me. I'll decide what to make after finishing the work. Would come back after the daybreak?

candidates.title: Pink Petal-like Dress
candidates.description: I will make a dress as beautiful as a pink petal! Would you bring 15 Soft Silky Cloth, 30 Red Herbs and 10 White Herbs to dye the cloth?

candidates.title: Beautiful Flower Decoration
candidates.description: I'll decorate it with humble but beautiful flowers. Please get me 5 pretty flowers, 5 pure flowers and 5 mysterious flowers

candidates.title: Dress of the Night Sky
candidates.description: I'll make a dress as dark as the night sky! I need cloth darker than the night sky. Would you bring 20 pieces of black cloth? Please.

candidates.title: Shawl of the Blazing Sun
candidates.description: I want to make a shawl which resembles the blazing sun in the sky. I think I need 20 hot hairs to make it.

candidates.title: Step of the Fairy
candidates.description: I'll make a dress as airy and elegant as the step of a fairy. A gorgeous one! I need 5 splendid fairy wings. It would be enough to make an elegant dress.

candidates.title: Sparkling Star
candidates.description: I want to sprinkle the dress with sparkling stats! Please get me 5 star dusts to decorate the dress with.

candidates.title: Suspicious Shadow
candidates.description: I heard the conversation between a suspicious person and Ian.

candidates.title: Midnight Snack Delivery
candidates.description: You delivered the midnight snack

candidates.title: Everything about Con-Chliina
candidates.description: If you are first to Con-Chliina, it's always nice to meet the purser and listen to its story.

candidates.title: Greetings to Captain Gamberi
candidates.description: Now that you got on to Con-Chliina to explore a new continent, it's time to meet the members. First talk with Captain Gamberi.

candidates.title: Say hi to recorder
candidates.description: If you want to know more about Lasagna and Con-Chliina, please meet the recorder.

candidates.title: To the kitchen
candidates.description: Everyone should be at the kitchen by now. Go to the kitchen.

candidates.title: To Purser
candidates.description: Check the whole ship, but there's not many to talk with. Let's go back to Purser.

candidates.title: Delivery to Chef
candidates.description: Didn't I told you to bring the Calunac to Chef? Food ingredients must be fresh, don't disappoint me!

candidates.title: When do we take off?
candidates.description: Departure sign is late, would you ask the Purser please?

candidates.title: Can we take off?
candidates.description: A large fogbank has appeared on the sea, check with the Chief Officer Stello if we can set sail today or not. You should perform any needed tasks immediately.

candidates.title: Crazy Dragon
candidates.description: It seems Dragon living inside cave is a bit angry these days. Dragon's condition is being checked daily by Vigilante member, please check what's wrong. Vigilante member should be staying near the south side of the bridge.

candidates.title: An errand out of nowhere
candidates.description: You really did it? I got chewed out from Sous Chef because of you, so you owe me this time. Get me 3 Basilac Clams. You can collect them by hunting Basilisks. This is for you, you know.

candidates.title: No news is not a good news
candidates.description: The guy who went to check Dragon's status hasn't come back yet. Something must have happened. Follow me to the cave.

candidates.title: How is the Dragon
candidates.description: Found a big scary enemy today, haven't seen Tartufi yet... Is Tartufi ok... Check please...

candidates.title: Basilisk Hunt
candidates.description: That Basilisk is strange today. What a pain. Take care of it for Machie, will ya.

candidates.title: Now I can leave
candidates.description: At this moment, Basilisk will not tease me any more. I will go to bed now. It's time to say good bye. Adios.

candidates.title: To Purser
candidates.description: If it is the first time to get on the Con-Chliina, please get some information from Mr.Purser.

candidates.title: Take care of grass thief
candidates.description: To help our cows eat their grass peacefully, hunt down 5 each of Grass Fabre and Reef Lunatics, and report back to Chief or Shepherd.

candidates.title: Can we set out the sailing?
candidates.description: We hardly know if we can start to sail because of the sea fog. Please ask Captain the details. The captain's cabin is right ahead

candidates.title: Crazy Dragon
candidates.description: It seems Dragon living inside cave is a bit angry these days. Dragon's condition is being checked daily by Vigilante member, please check what's wrong.

candidates.title: No news is not a good news
candidates.description: The guy went to check Dragon's status hasn't come back yet. Something must have happened. Follow me to the cave.

candidates.title: How is the Dragon
candidates.description: Found a big scary enemy today, I couldn't check Tartufi yet... Is Tartufi ok... Check please...

candidates.title: Chief Basilisk
candidates.description: Please meet Imoogi, the chief of Basilisks and ask to keep them calm. There is a device you for you to converse with somewhere up there.

candidates.title: Lord Imuk's message
candidates.description: Basilisk will continue their duty until that young one gives up the Yeouiju.

candidates.title: Basilisk Hunt
candidates.description: Please take care of those while I look for Yeouiju. Eliminating 20 of them usually do the work.

candidates.title: We can start sail now
candidates.description: Took care of Basilisk, Tartufi is now calmed down. Report back to First officer Stello.

candidates.title: Whole new world of taste
candidates.description: I'm trying to research the new continent's food ingredients. Would you get me 4 Fruits of Mastera? And I also do need 1 Cat shape hard biscuit.
candidates.goal: 4 Mastera's Fruit and 1 Cat shape Hard Biscuit

candidates.title: There also is a scary thing for me
candidates.description: Those appear at night and creep me out so much. They said new hero could help me out. Please meet Shamanyang and listen to the solution of my problem. Shamanyang lives at the entry way of the village.

candidates.title: Truth is alway harsh
candidates.description: Tell Boatswain the story I just told you.

candidates.title: Dirty Creatures
candidates.description: I would never hang out with Basilisk. So get me 20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks. Ofcourse there will be a treat.

candidates.title: Charm Effect Duration
candidates.description: Charm effect will go away at 4 O'clock

candidates.title: New Ingredient
candidates.description: As more contact with new continent people happening, we discovered that their charms are also effective. Today, we need 5 Basilrocks and 1 Holy water. Get them and report to Boatswain.

candidates.title: Dirty and Filty
candidates.description: Basilrock is so dirty and filty. 20 Basilrocks would do for today. Get them and report to Boatswain at once.

candidates.title: The basic are the best
candidates.description: Stick to the basic is the most effective way. Collect Basil 20 ea and Basil lock 5 ea. As soon as you get them, go to Boatswain right away.

candidates.title: Free time
candidates.description: Today's work is not finished. We can't research without our work is done. Come back after dawn time.

candidates.title: I love buns, too
candidates.description: It is said there is bun in the new continent. There is a similar food in Lasagna, so I would like to compare them. Can you bring me 20 of them?

candidates.title: Emergency food supplies
candidates.description: I wonder was Nyas used to feed all those sailors from Navi. Please get me 5 each of them.

candidates.title: Brilliant idea
candidates.description: Unmelting ice!! If it exists, that will be a revolution in keeping ingredients! That stimulates my curiosity! Please collect 20 of them!

candidates.title: Kaluna milk is in Danger!

candidates.title: Time to persuade
candidates.description: We'll be starved to death! Do something! Talk with them, stop them from eating anymore Kahlugnag!!

candidates.title: Babysitter
candidates.description: Let's find a baby needing care.

candidates.title: Processing Anchovy
candidates.description: They want to do something related to anchovy. Let's go to anchovy workshop.

candidates.title: Anchovy fishing ship
candidates.description: They want to get on the ship, so they might get used to anchovy shipping. Let's visit anchovy fishing ship.

candidates.title: Helpless...
candidates.description: I am sick and tired of hanging around with those two able to do nothing and having any will to do. I should return to Mr.Legalas without an alternative

candidates.title: I need the time on my own
candidates.description: I could do some work while they were not here. I should do some finishing, so please hang around with them for a while. And please tell Mr.Kalu about that I will deliver the procucts very soon.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery
candidates.description: I can make them stay away from Mr.Legalas to let him do his work. Could you deliver this lunch box to vigilante Panna in the cave? Of course, you should bring them along.

candidates.title: Delivery Complete Report
candidates.description: Finished deliver meal box to Vigilante member. Let's go back to Kalu.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery Time
candidates.description: Delivery time is not now. Wait for after dawn and come back.

candidates.title: Meal Box Delivery
candidates.description: Help me with Meal Box Delivery to Vigilante Pana inside the cave!
candidates.goal: Delivery to Vigilante member inside cave

candidates.title: Delivery Complete Report
candidates.description: Finished deliver meal box to Vigilante member. Let's go back to Kalu.

candidates.title: Interview with Captain
candidates.description: Talk with Captain Gamberi, ask him this and that. And tell me what you heard.

candidates.title: To Recorder
candidates.description: Finished interview with Captain Gamberi. Let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: Interview with the Chief
candidates.description: Talk with Peperoncino, ask him about Captain Gamberi and others. Come back and tell me what you heard. Chief Peperoncino is staying at Adventurer Club's diner.

candidates.title: To Recorder
candidates.description: Finished interview with Peperoncino. Let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: To Granma

candidates.title: Back to Recorder
candidates.description: Finished all the interview now, let's go back to Recorder.

candidates.title: The Competition
candidates.description: Take care of 10 Wild Hornets for the honey harvest competition, and report back to Chief or Florin.

candidates.title: Sticky ingredient

candidates.goal: Defeat Sweet Roda Frog and collect 5 Sticky Webfoots

candidates.title: Hunter's destination
candidates.description: They say hunter desert wolves are stealing dry fishes. Hunt down 10 of them and report back to Chief or Shepherd.

candidates.title: Secret Ingredient
candidates.description: Trance Spore's Mashroom spore is the secret ingredient of fish cake. Hunt 10 Trace Spore and bring back 5 mashroom spore to Chief or Shepherd.

candidates.title: Resting Time
candidates.description: Get some rest for hard work tomorrow.

candidates.title: Preparing for the Firework Festival
candidates.description: Gasters drop deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder. Bring me 10 Deadly Poisonous Powders and 1 Explosive Powder. Oh, and don't forget to cull Gasters by hunting 15 of them.
candidates.goal: 10 Deadly Poisonous Powders and 1 Explosive Powder

candidates.description: You need 10 magical snow flowers to make a snow flower bouquet. Please don't forget 1 carrot for decorating the snowman. - Marine

candidates.title: Getting through winter
candidates.description: Snow for children! Warm cotton clothes for children in cold region! Donate 10 warm cotton!

candidates.title: Cotton is being wrapped
candidates.description: Cotton is being wrapped. The wrapping seems be be finished by dawn so please come back after dawn! - Coti

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is WINTER!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters W. I. N. T. E. R.. Total of 6 letters. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Exchange festival card
candidates.description: The lucky word for you is FLOWER!! Please open snow flower envelope from your gift box. In the envelope, you can find these letters F. L. O. W. E. R. Total of 6 letter. - Twinkle

candidates.title: Card exchange is once a day
candidates.description: Alphabet card exchange is once a day. Okay? So please comeback after dawn! - Twinkle

candidates.title: Experiencing abnormal statuses

candidates.goal: Talk with the trainer Mainz again

candidates.goal: Speak with trainer Argos after 20 seconds

candidates.description: Take care of Sweets Drops monsters from fields and dungeons. Get back to Charles with 20 stolen COCOA BEANs.

candidates.title: Chocolate Delivery Complete
candidates.description: Finished chocolate delivery Charles requested. You can repeat after 4 AM.

candidates.title: Daily Draw Limitation
candidates.description: Sweets Shop Draw is only possible once a day. Today you've draw one alredy, so let's try after tomorrow 4 AM.

candidates.description: You read a notice on a board asking for adventurers to go on a once in a lifetime quest from Metz Brayde.

candidates.title: First examination
candidates.description: You find out that you have to go through a series of tests from Metz's friends. The first friend is in Morocc named Arian. You should go there and see him if you want to continue.

candidates.title: Fetching Items for Arian -1
candidates.description: Bring only what I tell you to bring. If you know that I'll be asking for something later and you happen to have it, I'll straight up jack it. Gimme ^FF0000100 Fluff^000000.

candidates.title: Quiz time!
candidates.description: Talk with Ganaan to progress to the next part of the exam.

candidates.title: Gen of Niflheim
candidates.description: Crayu says that you need to talk with someone in Niflheim named ^FF0000Gen^000000.

candidates.title: The Witch's Aid
candidates.description: Gen suggests that you go and see the witch and ask her to help you out. He also added that you should be wary of Serin.

candidates.title: Misfortunate of Niflheim
candidates.description: Serin says that you should talk with some of the people around Niflheim and see if you can be of any help to them.

candidates.title: The Queen's Symbol
candidates.description: You must earn the queen's favor in order to get the Symbol of the Nine Realms. Find where her lost mother, Agrboda has been sealed away by asking others if they know anything about her.

candidates.title: Knowledge of the Symbol
candidates.description: Serin said that you should someone who may have lived in Asgard and may know more about where Agrboda is sealed away.

candidates.title: Knowledge of Asgard
candidates.description: Valkyrie could not provide any answers for you. Perhaps someone in Niflheim can help you with your search for Agrboda.

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: Laichin has given you directions on how to find the 4 Soul Pieces of Agrboda. But what does he mean by "big" or "small" and what. You better ask him for clarification

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: For big, Look near the border of the map. For small, look in between the border and center. For very small, look near the center. Check out big 1 o'clock, big 5 o'clock, big 7 o'clock, and the small 6 o'clock.

candidates.title: Finding the Soul Pieces
candidates.description: For big, Look near the border of the map. For small, look in between the border and center. For very small, look near the center. Check out big 4 o'clock, big 10 o'clock, small 6 o'clock, and the very small 11 o'clock.

candidates.title: Agrboda's Soul
candidates.description: You have retrieved all of Agrboda's soul pices. You hear a voice speaking directly to you, "I'm... leaving my soul with you. Please guide me to the queen of the dead..."

candidates.title: Symbol of the Nine Realms
candidates.description: Lady Hell has rewarded you with the Symbol of the Nine Realms. Who should I tell first...

candidates.title: Serin's Ambitions
candidates.description: Kirkena has told you that Serin is intending on making a deal with the Dark Lord in order to remain in the living world. You must give her the Witch's Tonic so that she will forget her twisted ambitions.

candidates.title: Witch's Tonic
candidates.description: Kirkena has given you the Witch's Tonic and will send you to Serin's location so that you can erase her memories.

candidates.title: Serin's Release
candidates.description: You have successfully given the witch's tonic to Serin and she will no longer try to summon Dark Lord. You should tell Kirkena of your success.

candidates.title: Visit with Lady Hell
candidates.description: Kirkena says that Lady Hell wants to see you for some reason...

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: You have been rewarded with "The Sign" which will show all others that you are a great warrior whose courage was tested by the gods themselves. Who should I show this to first?

candidates.title: Dark Lord's return
candidates.description: You have failed to stop Serin from summoning Dark Lord. You had better tell Kirkena that you failed your mission.

candidates.title: Serin's Ambitions
candidates.description: Serin told you that Kirkena is trying to summon Dark Lord in to Rune Midgard. You must find a way to stop this from happening.

candidates.title: Dark Lord's return
candidates.description: You should probably tell Metz that you failed your mission.

candidates.title: Serin's Realization
candidates.description: You have stopped Serin's ambitious plans. You should tell Kirkena the witch what happened to you in Niflheim.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: Metz says that The Sign can be used to enter Valhalla but that you should first see Engel Howard who is the only person in Rune Midgard that knows how to handle it.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: Engel Howard has completed working with The Sign. He tells you that he is honored to have been given to the chance to work with it. Show it to Metz so that he knows your work is done.

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: Wait for Metz to finish his examination of The Sign. It should only take a couple of hours.
candidates.goal: Return to Metz after the timer has expired

candidates.title: The Sign
candidates.description: Wait for Engel to complete his work with The Sign and come back after the allotted time.
candidates.goal: Return to Engel after the timer has expired

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
