candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Elly might need some help. Talk with her.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Find the ingredients for Elly's cookies. You can get Wine from a pub in Juno, Cacaos from Yoyos, and flour and eggs from the Toast Stand in Juno.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Go to the Windmill Owner in the Lighthalzen slums to get flour and eggs for Cezu.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Bring the Delivery Package back to Cezu in Juno.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Bring the Delivery Package to Elly at the Kiel Hyre Academy.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Wait for Elly to finish baking the cookies.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Bring the Well-baked cookies to Elly's Grandfather at Kiel Hyre's cottage one map north of the Academy.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Go back to Elly and tell her that her Grandfather is not at the cottage.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Go back to Kiel Hyre's cottage again. Elly gave you a Cottage Key that should allow you to get through a side door.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You find a folded note that says "6 Forward, 3 Left, 3 Forward, 4 Left".

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You found a letter address to Elly. You had better bring it back to her.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Continue your conversation with Elly.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Search the cottage's study for signs that Elly's grandfather may have left for her. Go to the dormitory behind the Kiel Hyre Academy when you find something in the cottage.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You found a blank piece of paper with the Kiel Hyre Foundation Seal on it. It's strange that there would be a seal on a blank paper...

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have found a strange poem by using the blue ink on the blank paper written by the ^0000fflittle lost devil^000000. What could it possibly mean?

candidates.title: Mysterious World Map
candidates.description: Find something to help loosen the map from the wall.

candidates.title: Hidden poem
candidates.description: You found a piece of paper behind the map with a poem on it. There may be other clues hidden around here too.

candidates.title: Snake swords
candidates.description: Pressing the button in the pool, a claning noise came from the stairs at the hallway.

candidates.title: A dream?
candidates.description: Your mind has been swept away somewhere... Investigate the test tubes.

candidates.title: Old Copper Key
candidates.description: You have found an Old Copper Key inside of a Calabash. What could this key be for?

candidates.title: Green Keycard
candidates.description: You have found a Green Keycard inside of the locked box. What could this key be used for?

candidates.title: Steel Box
candidates.description: You have found a Steel Box inside of the safe behind the bookshelf. This could be what Elly's grandfather wanted her to find!

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You found a note in Elly's cookie basket that says that she saw the ghost. You vaguely remember her saying if she is cursed you must yell, "Wake up, Elly!".

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Elly woke up for a second and dropped a Golden Key and a Luxurious Button. See if Elly will wake up!

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You must find the factory's secret room at the grave in front of the dormitory. Use the Yellow Keycard to gain access.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have gained access to the factory. Find Allysia's hideout and use the Blue Keycard to gain access.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have convinced Allysia that you are helping Elly by showing her the Golden Key.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have obtained a Red Keycard that will allow you to access the secret areas of the factory. Use it to find Kiel Hyre.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have found Kiel Hyre trapped behind a door. He gave you a Metal Fragment that he asked you to take to Allysia.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Go to the Kiel Hyre Mansion in Lighthalzen. It is located just north of the Auction Hall. Present the Golden Key to be admitted to the premises.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Kiel Hyre is grateful for helping him. It seems your role here is done. Let Kiel Hyre rest for now and leave the mansion.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You were ambushed by agent Mitchell Layla from the Rekenber Corporation. She told you to find an old lady in Juno that may have more information about Allysia.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have obtained the Rosimier Mansion Keys. Search the Mansion thoroughly and tell the Old Lady what you found.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: The Old Lady says to talk with the Fisherman that lives south of the Kiel Hyre Academy. He was the one that found Allysia's body in the river...

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Investigate the hut near the Schwartzvalt guard camp just east of the Kiel Hyre Academy.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: You have enough information by now, so you should report back to Mitchell at the Kiel Hyre Mansion in Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Confront Kiel Hyre to find out who Kiehl really is and what his relationship to Rekenber is.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Kiel Hyre has given you a Power Device that will weaken Kiehl. Speak to Kiel Hyre when you are ready to be sent to Kiehl's room.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: The bottom of the vase reads "The rabbit often observes the door. Open the door."

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: The Big Door at the end of the room emits a chiming sound and the box pops open to reveal a Toy Key. Search for Kiehl in the dungeon.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Defeat the robot spawns.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Defeat Kiehl.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Retrieve Allysia's Ring from Kiehl's old body and escape.

candidates.title: Kiel Hyre Academy
candidates.description: Bring Allysia's Ring to Kiel Hyre in his mansion in Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Limberg's Request
candidates.description: Survey Leader Limberg asked you to get some missing supplies.

candidates.title: TPS Report
candidates.description: Survey Leader Limberg asked you another favor. Go down to the bottom of^0000FFNogg Road^000000 and get the ^0000FFTPS Report^000000 from the other team members there.

candidates.title: TPS Report
candidates.description: Surveyor Peter said that he didn't feel like doing his TPS Report. You're going to have to find the report from someone else.

candidates.title: TPS Report
candidates.description: Surveyor Bob has given you his TPS Report. Bring it back to Survey Leader Limberg.

candidates.title: Crack in the Wall
candidates.description: Limberg asked you to go back down to Nogg Road and find out what is in the crack in the wall that the Surveyor wrote in the TPS Report. Just jump in and see what's at the other end...

candidates.title: The Empty Lava Tube
candidates.description: You have taken the plunge down the empty lava tube and it led you down to the Thor Volcano... Report your findings to Survey Leader Limberg.

candidates.title: Meet with Father Bamph
candidates.description: An agent on the International Airship tells you that Father Bamph is expecting your arrival at Prontera Church. You should probably go and meet him there.

candidates.title: Meet with Larjes
candidates.description: Father Bamph tells you that a man of high rank suddenly disappeared a while ago and that he was last seen in Comodo. Find Larjes and he will assist you with your search for the lost official.

candidates.title: Report to Father Bamph
candidates.description: Larjes told you that that the official was kidnapped from an organization from Arunafeltz. You should report this to Father Bamph.

candidates.title: Travel to Rachel
candidates.description: Father Bamph asks you to go to Rachel on his behalf to continue the investigation of the missing official.

candidates.title: Travel to Veins
candidates.description: After eavesdropping on the conversation next to your table, you decide to go to Veins to see if you can find more Veins Striped Stickleback fish.

candidates.title: Frustrated Magistrate
candidates.description: Magistrate Al Hamad tells you that he's not really comfortable talking to complete strangers about his problems... Find someone who may know about the situation.

candidates.title: Interrogated Smugglers
candidates.description: You should ask the magistrate if he was able to interrogate the smugglers before they were taken away.

candidates.title: Written Orders
candidates.description: If you insist on learning more about the smugglers, then you need to bring a written order from a high ranking officer to Al Hamad.

candidates.title: Investigating
candidates.description: High Priest Zhed said that he was too preoccupied with other matters, but that High Priestess Niren may know something about the smugglers from Veins.

candidates.title: More Investigating
candidates.description: High Priestess Niren has asked you to find out if the high ranking official from Rune-Midgarts is still alive. Go to the Magistrate Al Hamad and he will provide usefull information for your journey.

candidates.title: Further Investigations
candidates.description: The Magistrate Al Hamad elaborated on their dealings with the smugglers and the high ranked Rune-Midgarts official. You should travel to veins and find out if anyone knows about their disappearances.

candidates.title: Kurdi's Father
candidates.description: The drunkard said something about a ghost out on sea. You should ask Kurdi's father about it since he's a fisherman and he might know something about it.

candidates.title: Karyn's Boat
candidates.description: Karyn's Dad is not allowed to go out to sea right now. But Karyn said that it should be okay if you borrow the boat. It is the only boat located in south beach so it shouldn't be difficult to find.

candidates.title: To the Island
candidates.description: Larjes has revealed that he has been following you and offers to help you sail to the monastery. Investigate the Island once you land there.

candidates.title: Investigating the Island
candidates.description: Larjes has decided to wait for you in the boat while you investigate the mysteries of the island.

candidates.title: The Research Note
candidates.description: You found a journal stained red with blood. It is hard to make out the entries but one of them states that the author learned to summon a creature. You should continue your investigation.

candidates.title: Regicide
candidates.description: You examined the Dead Man's body and found that he had a Token of King... That must mean that he was Tristam III... You should get back to Larjes and let him know.

candidates.title: Reporting the King's Death
candidates.description: The shocking news of Tristam III's death should not be taken lightly. You should report this and bring the Research Note to High Priestess Niren.

candidates.title: Delivery for Rooney
candidates.description: Find Lasda Midar and deliver the letter for Rooney.

candidates.title: Delivery for Rooney
candidates.description: Give the money that Lasda gave to you to Rooney.

candidates.title: Delivery for Rooney
candidates.description: Go back to Lasda Midar

candidates.title: Lasda's Request
candidates.description: Lasda has asked you to find his friend in a temporary prison in Morocc.

candidates.title: Jesse's Request
candidates.description: Prison Ward Jesse has asked you to bring him 1 dish of Fried Monkey Tails. If you bring it to him he said he will let you in the temporary prison.

candidates.title: Sir Krieg's Approval
candidates.description: Find Sir Krieg somewhere in Morocc. If you get his approval, Jesse will let you into the temporary prison.

candidates.title: Sir Krieg's Trust
candidates.description: Gain Sir Krieg's Trust by getting a letter of approval. Maybe you should ask someone who knows something about Vitre...

candidates.title: Sir Krieg's Trust
candidates.description: You have obtained a letter of recommendation from Lasda Midar. Bring it back to Sir Krieg and he might let you into the prison.

candidates.title: Into the prison
candidates.description: Sir Krieg has sent word to the prison ward to let you talk with Vitre.

candidates.title: Jail Break
candidates.description: Vitre needs some items to help him get out of the temporary prison. Find someone who knows where to get the items he needs.

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Hianna will lend you her Megaphone for 500,000 zeny if you act as bodyguard to her Dancers. Find the Dancers and escort them to the Schwaltzvalt Republic.

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Talk with Hianna's Dancers.

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Talk with the Hotel Manager.

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Talk with the mysterious man

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Talk with the Hotel Manager.

candidates.title: Bodyguard work
candidates.description: Go back to Hianna and get the Megahpone. Remember you also need to pay her 500,000 zeny to borrow it.

candidates.title: Jail Break
candidates.description: Bring 1 Megaphone and 1 Violin to Vitre to help him escape the tempoary prison in Morocc.

candidates.title: Jail Break
candidates.description: Talk with Vitre

candidates.title: Vitre's Songs
candidates.description: Find Vitre's Friends in this order: Chada in Prontera, Ghez in Geffen, and Nosdan in Comodo listen to their songs and sing them back to Vitre.

candidates.title: Vitre's Songs
candidates.description: You've heard Chada's song, now it's time to find Ghez in Geffen.

candidates.title: Vitre's Songs
candidates.description: You've heard Ghez's song, now it's time to find Nosdan in Comodo.

candidates.title: Vitre's Songs
candidates.description: You've heard the final song from Nosdan. Time to go back and sing all three songs to Vitre.

candidates.title: Vitre the Spy
candidates.description: The Secret Service have taken Vitre away for Espionage. You should probably go back to Lasda and let him know what happened to Vitre.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Oh, thank you so much! You don't understand how much I dread those Airships. Now, would you please deliver these books to ^ff0000Mr. Karlomoff^000000 near the Juno Library?

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: It would be a great help to me if you could get this report to her right away. Ah, her name is Rodafrian. I'm certain you can find her somewhere in that desert town.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Find Mondo in Mt. Mjolnir. Tell him your version of the story The great serpent swallowed the sea. The eagle of the rainbow swallowed the serpent. Then the eagle built its nest. A nest upon the swallowed sea.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Ahh, if you want to learn more, then you should try to find the kid that was singing the song. Hmm, he might be around ^3131ddthe river near here^000000. Hopefully it won't be too hard to find him.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Deliver the herbs from the Exhausted-Looking Woman to Father Bamph in Prontera Church.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Please visit Bonnie Imbullea in Mount Mjolnir to see if you can learn more about that song, or about what happened after the attempted exorcism of the Jormungand curse.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Head back to Prontera Church and tell Father Bamph what you learned from speaking to Bonnie Imbullea.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Come with me, adventurer, to the secret ceremonial grounds for the royal family. Just use the switch hidden within the bookshelf and I will meet you there.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: You've examined the body of the king's first son, the crown prince. Examine the body of the second prince.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: You've examined the body of the king's second son. Examine the body of the third prince.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Brave adventurer, would you please visit the Assassin Guild in Morocc and see if you can learn anything about how we can verify whether poison was used to defeat the princes?

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: There is an Assassin's Private Pub in the 7 o'clock direction in Morocc. Go find someone named ^3131ffMarjana^000000 inside.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Well, it's easier for me to visit Rodafrian now. She's much closer than Father Bamph, so I guess that I'll go talk with her first.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Well, it's more important that I go see Father Bamph and investigate the princes bodies. I better head over to Prontera right away.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Drat, she didn't give me any help... All I did was reveal a huge secret to her that she might spread around! Oh well, I guess I better head back to the priests...

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Rodafrian seemed very happy and began to read through Karlomoff's report. For now, it would be best to return to Father Bamph.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Then, would you please bring 1 Yellow Gemstone and 1 Green Potion to the secret ceremonial grounds as soon as you can? I will wait over there for you once again.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: The solution worked to remove the scale marks from the princes. Report your findings to Father Bamph.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Father Bamph thanks you for helping them find out the truth. Speak to Father Biscuss and relate your findings to him as well.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Father Bamph thanks you for helping them find out the truth. Speak to Bonnie Imbullea and tell her that it was not her fault.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Tell Bonnie Imbullea what you have discovered about the prince's deaths.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: After telling Bonnie Imbullea the truth, you should speak to Rodfrian for the last time.

candidates.title: Gaebolg Family Curse
candidates.description: Talk with Father Bamph one more time.

candidates.title: Missing boy Mikhail
candidates.description: You have agreed to find the Gallina's timid son Mikhail. He couldn't have gone far, search around and see if he is hiding somewhere.

candidates.title: Mikhail's Whereabouts
candidates.description: Your only clue is to go to the ^3131FFInn ^000000"^3131FFSticky Herb Tree^000000". You might be able to find out something about Mikahil there.

candidates.title: Missing boy Mikhail
candidates.description: The Landlord said that you should speak to the Pub Owner as he was the last person to speak to Mikhail.

candidates.title: The isolated swamp
candidates.description: You find out from Victor that he told Mikhail of an isolated swamp on a nearby island. Mikhail is not likely to be there but you have to check just in case.

candidates.title: Back to the Village
candidates.description: You found no traces of Mikhail at the swamp. You've decided to check the village for any signs of him.

candidates.title: High-strength Adhesive
candidates.description: You've promised Mikhail that you will make the paste for him. Talk with Victor to find out what materials you need to make the paste.

candidates.title: Back to the swamp
candidates.description: Victor said that you need to go back to the swamp on the island near Moscovia and bring back the ingredients for the paste. Search the swamp until you get all 10 sticky herbs.

candidates.title: Make the paste
candidates.description: You have the 10 sticky herbs for the paste. If you also have 1 medicine bowl you should bring them back to Victor so that he can make it for you.

candidates.title: Fixing the Matrushka
candidates.description: Victor has created the paste for you. Bring it to Mikhail so that he can fix the broken Matrushka.

candidates.title: Report to Gallina
candidates.description: Tell Gallina that her son Mikhail is safe and sound.

candidates.title: Banishing Winter
candidates.description: You decide to help Baba Yaga make her spell to banish winter.

candidates.title: Making the magic dust
candidates.description: Baba Yaga asked you to bring back the following: ^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs, 5 Spawn, 20 Wings of Red Bat, 10 Sticky Mucus, 10 Witch Starsand, 10 Fine Grit, 1 Detonator, 5 Red Blood, 10 Burning Hearts, and 1 Diamond.^000000

candidates.title: Making the magic dust
candidates.description: Baba Yaga asked you to bring back the following: ^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs, 5 Spawn, 20 Wings of Red Bat, 10 Witch Starsand, 10 Fine Grit, 1 Detonator, 5 Red Blood, 10 Burning Hearts, and 1 Diamond.^000000

candidates.title: The Dragon's Lair
candidates.description: Now that you have the ingredients for the magic dust, Baba Yaga has asked you to find a magic gourd bottle from the lair of a sleeping dragon.

candidates.title: The Magic Gourd Bottle
candidates.description: You found the Magic Gourd Bottle! Bring it back to Baba Yaga the Horrible.

candidates.title: Containing People's Speech
candidates.description: You must find and contain the voices of 3 people. From a child, a young person and a middle-aged person. You need to contain the wish phrase, I don't want winter to come, from the 3 different people.

candidates.title: Containing People's Speech
candidates.description: You have contained the speech of a child, a young person and a middle-aged person. Bring the Magic Gourd Bottle back to Baba Yaga, the Horrible.

candidates.title: Csar's Request
candidates.description: The Csar has requested you to help Baba Yaga complete her spell to make sure that winter does not return.

candidates.title: Baba Yaga's Secret Medicine
candidates.description: You have successfully made Baba Yaga's Secret Medicine. Drop the bottle in the middle of the village to make sure that winter does not come back.

candidates.title: Winter is Banished
candidates.description: You broke the bottle of Baba Yaga's Secret Medicine in the center of town. Report to Csar Aleksay III and tell him that you have banished winter from returning.

candidates.title: Legends from Moscovia
candidates.description: Learn stories and legends from the ancestors of Moscovia.

candidates.title: The Moving Island
candidates.description: Investigate the legend of The Moving Island.

candidates.title: In Search of The Moving Island
candidates.description: Find Ibanoff, to ask about acquiring a boat that can take you to The Moving Island.

candidates.title: In Search of The Moving Island
candidates.description: Listen to the stories of an old sailor, in order to acquire a boat that can take you to The Moving Island.

candidates.title: Mr. Ibanoff's New Friend
candidates.description: Ask your new friend, Ibanoff, about borrowing his boat to go to The Moving Island.

candidates.title: Repairing Charabel
candidates.description: Gather materials to repair Mr. Ibanoff's boat.
candidates.goal: 10 Strange Steel Pieces, 10 Rusty Screws, 5 Flexible Tubes, 10 Jubilees

candidates.title: As the Tide Turns
candidates.description: Ask Mr. Ibanoff to set sail to find the Moving Island... But you must do it before the tide rises!

candidates.title: Departing
candidates.description: While the tide is still low... hoist the sails! Navigate your way to the Moving Island!

candidates.title: The Moving Island?
candidates.description: Have you found the Moving Island? What is that??? Walk around the deck of the ship, to find a spot where you can get a better look...

candidates.title: The Moving Island???
candidates.description: What is that? What have you found???

candidates.title: The Aged Stranger
candidates.description: Could this all be true?!? Are you truly riding on the back of a... Whale Island!?! ... Talk with the old man if you want to return safely to the mainland.

candidates.title: Whale Island!
candidates.description: You have found Whale Island! Talk with Mr. Ibanoff if you ever want to go out to sea to find it again!

candidates.title: A Story for the Csar
candidates.description: Go meet with the Csar of Moscovia. Surely, he would appreciate the grandiose tale of Whale Island!

candidates.title: Evidence for the Csar
candidates.description: Csar Aleksay III has asked for evidence of the Whale Island. It looks like you may have to return to the moving island...
candidates.goal: Find your ride back to Whale Island!

candidates.title: Before Sunset
candidates.description: Ask Mr. Ibanoff to set sail to find Whale Island... But you must do it before the sun has set!

candidates.title: Departing
candidates.description: While the sun is still out... hoist the sails! Navigate your way to Whale Island!

candidates.title: Whale Island!
candidates.description: You have found Whale Island! Investigate! Explore! See if you can find evidence for the Csar.

candidates.title: Materials for Evidence
candidates.description: Talk with Mr. Ibanoff as soon as you have gathered all of the materials.
candidates.goal: 30 Log, 20 Tough Vines, 20 Antelope Horn, 10 Sea-otter Fur

candidates.title: Mysterious Musical Instrument
candidates.description: Wait patiently, as the old man creates your musical instrument.

candidates.title: Gusli
candidates.description: You now have a Gusli! You should really learn to play it before showing it to the Csar as evidence!

candidates.title: Gusli
candidates.description: Beautiful! You can play the Gusli! Now it's time to show off your musical skills to the Csar of Moscovia, thereby letting him see evidence of the existence of Whale Island!

candidates.title: Shafka
candidates.description: If you want a Shafka hat, bring the materials that Irina has asked for, so she can make you one!
candidates.goal: 20 Nine Tails, 10 Yarn, 10 Soft Silk, 20 Sea-otter Fur, 1 Spool

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Sir Chilias'Tyus says that you must speak to Clanux Heffron in Prontera behind the Prontera church.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have refused Sir Chilias'Tyus' request. Maybe you should reconsider...

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Search the old Swordman training grounds at the southeastern area of Prontera for any clues.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You may have insulted Clanux Heffron. You should try to make amends with him so that you can complete your task.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found a message that reads ^4d4dff"Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO."^000000

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You've received a Cogwheel from Clanux Heffron. Remember that the message you found said ^4d4dff"Veggie Lady N9 W3 BINGO."^000000

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: The Veggie Lady gave you some kind of password ^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000. Tell Clanux Heffron about it.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Enter in the password that the Veggie Lady gave you into the Unknown Machine ^4D4DFF 3847147298^000000.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have received a Prontera Tablet. Bring it back to Sir Chilia'Tyus in Morocc.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You decide that you don't want to tell all of the details you have discovered to Clanux Heffron. Report your findings to Sir Chilia'Tyus in Morocc.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Chilias'Tyus says that he's sure that the next tablet piece is in Payon. Find Grout'he Tuccok in Payon.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Grout'he has given you a Skirt of Virgin and marked your mini-map of where he found it.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found something written on the ceiling of the pagoda that says "This garment is one size fits all." Tell Grout'he about the message.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found a Pile of stone that says, "I used to pray for peaceful days here." Tell Grout'he about the message.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found Dried Fish with a message that says, "Green Herbs are very useful for getting rid of fish smells." Tell Grout'he about the message.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found a Vat with a message, "What will it be? Wine or Grape Juice? Oh, but I much prefer wine." Tell Grout'he about the message.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You found a message from Tyus, return to Grout'he and let him know what you found under the Wooden Floor.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You told Grout'he what the slab under the wooden floor said. He tells you to check the huge stone statue in the Archer Village to the north.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have obtained a Payon Tablet from the Buddha Statue. You should bring it back to Chilias'Tyus in Morocc.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have received a Morocc Tablet. Chilias'Tyus says that you should travel to Geffen and find a man named Welshyun.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Welshyun asked you to find his student Enoz in the Geffen tower. Make sure that he has the report called "Monster Life in the Geffen Area."

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Your insult may not have been such a great idea. Try to make amends with Welshyun.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Welshyun says that he is thirsty. Bring him a potion and see if you can parch his throat.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: It seems Enoz has lost the Monster Life book. Return to Welshyun and tell let him know.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Welshyun says you should deliver the book to Enoz at Geffen tower and bring back 1 Blue Gemstone when you return.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Return to Welshyun and don't forget to bring 1 Blue Gemstone. If he asks you a strange question, answer him "Valaskjalf"

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have received a Geffen Tablet. Bring all of the tablets back to Sir Chilias'Tyus in Morocc.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: Chilias'Tyus says that Welshyun is the only one who can combine the tablet pieces into its complete form.

candidates.title: The Eye of Hellion
candidates.description: You have the Completed Tablet. Bring it to Chilias'Tyus so he knows that the task is complete.

candidates.title: RPS with Troy
candidates.description: You can only challenge Troy once the timer has expired.

candidates.title: Shipwreck escape
candidates.description: You must escape from ship that wrecked on desert island after a storm. Let's search for wounded people that still on board.

candidates.title: First battle
candidates.description: Find ship repair materials that was stolen by Poring. I was asked by crew to bring back 2 piece of Lumbers. Defeat Poring and retrieve the wood.
candidates.goal: Deliver 2 piece of Lumbers to crew

candidates.title: Best medicine for motion sickness
candidates.description: I decide to help Reno, a friend whom I met while traveling, by finding something to relieve his motion sickness. Let's ^4d4dffask about Herbal Medicine to Therapist^000000 in ^4d4dffCriatura Academy Clinic^000000.
candidates.goal: Ask about Herbal Medicine to Therapist

candidates.title: Basic herbal medicine
candidates.description: The terapist asking you to find potion ingredient, Red Herb. Find ^4d4dffRed Plant^000000 in ^4d4dffFront door of Criatura academy^000000.
candidates.goal: Find Red Plant outside Criatura academy

candidates.title: Save location!
candidates.description: Good thing I got.

candidates.title: Good news for Reno
candidates.description: I think I'll give it to Reno what I got from the therapist..

candidates.title: My first friend
candidates.description: I have found a good friend

candidates.title: First Battle
candidates.description: Find ship repair materials that was stolen by Poring. I was asked by crew to bring back 2 piece of Lumbers. Defeat Poring and retrieve the wood.
candidates.goal: Deliver 2 piece of Lumbers to crew

candidates.title: Advice for training
candidates.description: 스프라키는 '페이욘'에서 뭔가 할 일이 있을지도 모른다며 '페이욘'행을 권했다. 이즈루드 광장의 카프라 직원을 통해 '페이욘'으로 가자.

candidates.title: Adventurer Guild Call
candidates.description: 이즈루드 '크리투라 학원'에서 급히 찾는다는 전갈을 받았다. 스프라키에게 가보자.

candidates.title: Chasing Goddess follower
candidates.description: 기사 메리크는 '알베르타'에서 '브랜'에 대한 제보를 받았다고 한다. '브랜'의 행방 확인을 위해 '알베르타'에서 베드로와를 만나 정보를 확인하자.

candidates.title: Suspicious shipwreck
candidates.description: 베드로와나는 '브랜'이 배를 빌려타고 난파선으로 향했다고 한다. 난파선 근처를 조사해 진입한 뒤 내부를 수색하자.

candidates.title: Poring Village
candidates.description: 낙원단에서 전해진 의뢰로 프론테라 인근에서 퍼지고 있는 '포링마을'에 대한 소문의 진위를 가려야 한다. '프론테라 서쪽'에서 정보를 모아보자.

candidates.title: To shipwreck island
candidates.description: '브랜'은 아무래도 난파선의 섬에 숨은 것 같다. 알베르타 항구 근처의 선원을 통해 '난파선'으로 이동해 조사하자.

candidates.title: Lighthalzen Pickpocket
candidates.description: Wait at least 5 minutes before trying to talk with the "Suspicious Guy" again.

candidates.title: Criminal Investigation
candidates.description: Agent York has asked you to find Vince Noir near the Geffen fountain.

candidates.title: Ling Mynmei
candidates.description: Vince Noir gives you a Raccoon Doll and tells you to find Ling Mynmei at a bar in Geffen and bring the doll to her.

candidates.title: Freeing Mynmei
candidates.description: Talk with Old Lady Kroot and convince her to release Ling Mynmei from her work servitude contract.

candidates.title: Arm Wrestle an old lady
candidates.description: You've challenged Old Lady Kroot to an old fashioned arm wrestling contest. Pay her 5,000 zeny and try your luck beating her.

candidates.title: The best way to a woman's heart...
candidates.description: Bring a bomber steak to Old Lady Kroot and she'll reduce the payment of Ling Mynmei's contract to 50,000 zeny.

candidates.title: Pay off the old lady
candidates.description: Pay off Ling Mynmei's contract by giving 100,000 zeny to Old Lady Kroot.

candidates.title: Ling Mynmei is free!
candidates.description: Tell Ling Mynmei that you have successfully purchased her contract from Old Lady Kroot.

candidates.title: Howard Moon
candidates.description: Find Howard Moon who is working somewhere in Geffen.

candidates.title: Flooding the Storage Room
candidates.description: Howard Moon needs your help to flood the fuudmaart storage room. Find the 4 controls around the city of Geffen and switch them to OFF and it will flood the fuudmaart storage room.
candidates.goal: Talk with Howard Moon after you've found all 4 Flood Controls

candidates.title: Flood Control 1
candidates.description: You've switchted the first flood control device.

candidates.title: Flood Control 2
candidates.description: You've switchted the second flood control device.

candidates.title: Flood Control 3
candidates.description: You've switchted the third flood control device.

candidates.title: Flood Control 4
candidates.description: You've switchted the fourth flood control device.

candidates.title: Naota
candidates.description: Find the last bandmember Naota inside of the domestic airship. You need to board the airship from Hugel, Juno, Einbroch, or Lighthalzen.

candidates.title: Sabotaging Jymmy's operation
candidates.description: Drug the chicken and place 3 cheat detecting devices on the machines in the airship casino. Speak to Dealer when you've done all of these to catch them in the act.

candidates.title: Drugged Chicken
candidates.description: That should be good enough to tranquilize Jymmy's goons.

candidates.title: Cheat Detector 1
candidates.description: You've successfully installed the first cheat detector

candidates.title: Cheat Detector 2
candidates.description: You've successfully installed the second cheat detector

candidates.title: Cheat Detector 3
candidates.description: You've successfully installed the third cheat detector

candidates.title: Caught in the act
candidates.description: Now that you've got evidence that Jymmy's running a scam, talk with Naota again.

candidates.title: Sabotaging the ship's engine
candidates.description: Go to the front of the ship past the casino and flip the switch that looks like a sword to enter the ship's lower deck area.

candidates.title: Fire the Cannon
candidates.description: Aim the cannon at the ship's engines and fire away!

candidates.title: Find Jymmy the Thumb
candidates.description: Now that you've got the engine prepped for sabotage, confront Jimmy the Thumb in the Captain's Quarters.

candidates.title: Parachuting off of the Airship

candidates.description: Jekan will need a few items to make a copy of the records. 2 Slick Paper and 1 Oil Paper from Amatsu, 3 Feather of Birds from Morocc, and 20 Blue Gems from Geffen.
candidates.goal: Bring these items to Jekan to make him finish the copy faster

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Your copy of the records has a weird search magic on it. To find specific info, you need to first check for broad topic then get more specific: crusader 3rd_company 3rd_platoon 1st_squad.
candidates.goal: Look up the individual members names to find out where they are nowadays

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Find Zan Huadoku inside the Geffen Blacksmith guild. Observe politeness when asking him how he is doing before jumping in to ask about their top secret final mission. Yeah, that's the ticket!

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Zan Huadoku has told you all that you think is possible. You should head to Morocc to find "Cuaque Donon" who was last seen at the Inn. You have a feeling that you may need to be stubborn in Morocc.

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Cuaque Donon is in a Rogue Guild hideout probably at "Fortress Saint Darmain (South)" (use map ctrl + ~) The password to enter should be "Aragham never hoarded upgrade items".
candidates.goal: Cuaque is suffering from extreme PTSD and "freaks out" so pretending he is a young child would help, maybe even a dolly hahaha

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Cuaque said the squad found the "Megingjard" and an argument broke out... You need to know more about that argument, perhaps Jack.O in Alberta on the docks can help.
candidates.goal: He is still an active crusader, so I think talking to him will be much more straight forward

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Jack.O found some relief from "Green Herb". Perhaps I should pass that advice onto the other Crusaders I meet. Emma Searth is in Aldebaran, a quick boat to Izlude and a Kafra warp to Aldebaran will have me there in a jiffy!
candidates.goal: Maybe I should also contemplate a memory aid for these crusaders, something to help them remember their place like a "Bookclip" from a "Rideword"

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: I think I need to hurry to see "The Nineball" he works as a bouncer in the Jawaii inn. I heard there is an ex-barkeep of Jawaii working in the Central Prontera Pub maybe he knows a way to get to Jawaii without tying the knot!
candidates.goal: Someone named Nineball and who is a bouncer probably is pretty closed mouth kinda guy, I should keep talking until he at least reacts to my questions..

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Exit Jawaii with a Butterflywing or drink yourself back to Rune-Midgarts. Get to Comodo to see "Royal Myst" at the south casino. Morocc to Comodo is usually the easiest way to warp to Comodo.
candidates.goal: A "couple" of shots of "Alcohol" can loosen Royal Myst's tongue..

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: You've spoken to all the crusaders that are still alive, apparently something happened, blame was passed and Crusader Egnigem died in the process. You should return to Prontera Castle and inform him of your findings.
candidates.goal: A kafra hop from Comodo to Morocc to Prontera is quick unless you're saved in Prontera

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: You should talk with the last member of the 1st squad, the late Egnigem. A Kafra hop from Prontera to Morocc to Comodo then to Umbala and then a journey north to the Tree of Life to Nifflheim can get you to him.
candidates.goal: Listen to Egnigem and see what you can do to fix this

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: By Odin's mercy this is terrible, you never believed that a holy Crusader would do such an evil act to claim the power of Megingjard. Be brave and return to the Crusader Headquarters and tell Max Von Shedough what you know.

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Max Von Shedough has accepted my report, and is deeply troubled by its contents, but part of me truly believes that despite good intentions the political reality may intervene to keep justice from being had.
candidates.goal: I must tell Egnigem at least of the outcome, he deserves at least to know what he died for.

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Egnigem has blessed you with all his remaining strength. You have a feeling that there is one special someone that he would want to know his fate, You must tell Emma Searth about his fate.

candidates.title: Seal of Megingjard
candidates.description: Emma can't Remember, but she can feel the loss. Your faith in Justice is weak now... You must tell Max Von Shedough he is the Judge and he should share this burden of guilt.
candidates.goal: Return to Max Von Shedough at Prontera Castle
